rule: Brain-to-Text '25 (T15), M4-12 fixed0 phoneme log-probs on the val_eval part of the HDF5 val file (701 trials). Trial id = <session>|val|<i>, where i is the position of the trial inside the session's val_eval list, NOT its index in the HDF5 file data_val.hdf5. See id_rule.
id_rule: For each session folder (order of id_sessions = sorted session names), list the trial groups of data_val.hdf5 in sorted key order, index j = 0, 1, 2, ... Even j = val_select (calibration, never in this split). Odd j = val_eval. i = (j - 1) / 2, so the HDF5 val index is j = 2i + 1. Trials listed in 'excluded' (out-of-lexicon words) keep their i (no renumbering) and are not in the split. Held-out order = id_sessions order, then i ascending. Rebuild: fidetype.benchmark.hallucination.ids_from_rule(split).
